q: Welcome to Officina. This is a card: the team never asks you in its own windows. Every question comes here, with options. Tap one.
context: Your answer goes straight to the coordinator, who passes it to the right agent. Cards that wait on you are listed under 'For you'.

q: Every deliverable moves along a lane: author → Judge (reviewers) → Folder Manager (files it) → you. Open 'Lanes' to see where each one is and who is waiting.
context: If you mark up a file (PDF boxes or 3D pins) and press 'send', the lane opens again and the author gets your notes.

q: Each evening the agents give each other feedback (1-10 plus 'what would help you'). It is not a competition: it shows where an agent needs a tool, context or a better brief from you.
context: You can vote too, on each agent's profile page. Agents also write Requests: things you could do so they work better. Reply there; the coordinator relays your answer at once.

q: Agents never send anything outside on their own. Mail and chat texts arrive as Drafts: you copy and send them yourself.
context: Safety rules: a denied permission = the agent stops and asks; backups before any model edit; one test document in the CAD app for agents.
